graphEvents.label: OpenCode store has no injected-context row
Advisor text is assistant output in 10 of 24

label: All 24 OpenCode arena sessions are present in the store and their 562 message rows are 513 assistant, 24 idle, 24 user and 1 synthetic, with no injected-context or system row type, so the store keeps every session but no record of what the plugin injected.

Ten of 24 sessions contain Advisor: and every hit is in an assistant row, so a store-based delivery check would report 10 of 24 delivered and 14 missing while counting model output as delivery evidence.

The build is a new prompt-free write rather than a new reader: the plugin writes a bounded receipt (session id, block hash, runtime, epoch) after observeEmittedAdvisorBlock and briefDelivered gains an opencode branch that reads the receipt, never the session text.

The receipt key space is proven: all 24 OpenCode run lines carry a sessionId and projectDir, and SPECKIT_ is already in the behaviour runner child-environment allowlist, so a SPECKIT_ metrics path reaches the plugin without an allowlist change.

direction: A reader-only delivery fix against the OpenCode session store
reason: 10 of 24 sessions would read as delivered on assistant text, so the check would be wrong on 14 rows and would treat model output as evidence
